author: Jonla29
body:
Sup Poobag. Im THE Jonla. You may recognise me as a legend or that dick with 3 pages of infractions. However im sending you this now live from London with two things on my mind. One poo and the other is just how Avicus has changed recently. For example I remember in my youth Avicus had over 700 players online at almost every hour of the day but now... well you can see the picture I have sent with this email. 

My friends (Cos i have some) Have shown me the Nebula games. I can see only one game running but back in the old days (When I was unbanned) I could choose a range of games. And by the way I think the lobby is hideous. My two year old sister could make a better job from the remains of her nappies or dipers as you American humans say. 
Also the amount of people voting and buying ranks has decreased possibly due to the staff, lack of rewards or other servers being better and more worthy of a vote. However I always voted and I made up roughly 50% of the votes. My friend made the other 50%. If you unbanned me or at least showed any signs of love for your server I could help you make your server better again (Or at least not desolate) by advertising in the local Newspaper and By making videos (if you let me) on my Youtube channel with 7 thousand followers. Sub me today at Avicusneedsplayers.com

Due to the fact this email looks short here is something I made. How does a void electron dose the strategy? The bias pushes her understanding bath opposite a backlog. The initiate look discriminates after the mercury. The culprit captains a detail. A complex rests upon the ozone inside the sorted adult. The fork resides in the breath. 
 
So to sum up. You will unban me or your server will go to 0/1000 players. You will make a loss of $Several Thousand and you will be the laughing stock of China. Other servers who host other games such as you (Skywars etc) Will have your unloyal players join them. Also your staff really need a change. Apart from the person who reads this :) I <3 you :)

Jonla out. I would swear here but... *************************************************
